description: Defines the data transfer object class 'TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails' used for encapsulating details about the last action time at work, including date, time, timezone, and status information within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails
classes.description: A data transfer object for storing details about the last action time at work, including status, UTC and user-specific date/time, and timezone offset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the properties with optional parameters.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the status/state of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcDate
methods.description: Returns the UTC date of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the UTC time of the last action.

methods.name: getUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user-specific date of the last action.

methods.name: getUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-specific time of the last action.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset associated with the last action.
